Built-in preset

Stroke

Geometry flow

Follows surface curvature. Long strokes stop at occlusions and sharp changes.

Light & depth

Hard contours

Edges between faces above the angle threshold are calculated first. Hidden edges are removed, and hatch lines stop at the visible contours.

Render detail controls the workspace preview. Set full image dimensions and framing in Export PNG.

Depth outlines

Shares the global or object setup used by Hatching. Saved with your presets and scenes.

Adds lines at depth jumps within visible geometry. Outer silhouettes keep their separate outline settings.

Depth threshold is a fraction of the nearer surface's distance from the camera. Minimum depth jump uses scene units. Slope rejection reduces lines on smoothly tilted surfaces. Minimum edge length removes small fragments; smoothing softens pixel steps.
